name: limits-aware
description: Keeps Claude Code aware of subscription session (5h) and weekly limits at no cost, nudges it to wrap up by band, and compacts after it saves its notes.

autoCompact.title: Compaction near the limit
autoCompact.description: agent: compact only when Claude calls compact_after_turn. fallback: also ask Claude to save notes and compact when a turn ends in WRAP/STOP. off: never compact.

minContextPercent.title: Minimum context for fallback compaction (%)
minContextPercent.description: The fallback leaves smaller conversations alone; compacting them saves little.
